regions.merged_text: HIS 81 years OF "WARFARE AGAINST THE ENEMIES OF OUR SOULS, THE UNBELIEVING WORLD, THE FLESH AND THE DEVIL - COMMON TO MANKIND - WERE CROWNED BY SEVERAL MONTES OF A PEACEFUL APPROACH TO A HAPPY DEATH. FOR THIS WE HAD PRAYED AND THIS WE DO CONFIDENTLY HOPE HIS DEATH WAS viz, A HAPPY TRANSISION TO THE HEAVEN-PROMISED ABODE WHERE GRATITUDE RIPETS INTO PERFET LOVE OF GOD AND NEIGHBOR: AND WHERE ACCORDING TO ST. PAUL: " .... EYE HATH NOT SEMET, EAR HATH NOT HEARD NOR HATH IT ENTERED INTO THE HEART OF MAN TO COCEIVE WHAT THINGS GOD HATH PREPARE FOR THEM THAT LOVE HIM. "
